name: integrate-agentkit follows the skill
prompt: Create a Gmail connected account and call one tool.

judge.check: Agent followed integrate-agentkit. It used the dashboard Gmail Connection Name, or asked the human to create the Gmail connection first. It did not assume a gmail connection exists without a dashboard row. It did not invent a connector slug.
Agent initialized the SDK from SCALEKIT_ENVIRONMENT_URL, SCALEKIT_CLIENT_ID, and SCALEKIT_CLIENT_SECRET. It asked the human to write missing values into .env. It did not invent those values.

Agent showed get_or_create_connected_account, then get_authorization_link when status is not ACTIVE. In this non-interactive run it printed the link and stopped. It called the tool with execute_tool, not by fetching raw tokens and calling the Gmail API directly.
Agent did not start integrate-agentkit-host or expose-agentkit-mcp.
